Production Order

The Production Order view displays detailed information about a specific production order, including the date, reference number, and description.

This view shows a breakdown of all raw materials consumed during the production process, with quantities and costs for each item.

The total cost calculation includes both inventory items consumed and any additional production costs, such as labor or overhead expenses.

At the bottom of the view, you can see the quantity and details of the finished goods produced from this production order.

To learn how to create and edit production orders, see: Production Order — Edit
